name: Samsung Q80A
summary: The Q80A is the TV Vetro is developed on. Published Q80A records cover launcher behavior, root-agent startup and signed self-updates. In 0.7.0 the firmware update lock and Quick boot were tried on a Q80A on firmware 2310.0; many other 0.7.0 changes are marked in the changelog as not yet tried on a TV.

name: Samsung Q70A
summary: A community report with a diagnostic export showing the app, the service and the root agent running.

name: Samsung Q60A
summary: Reported working. The reporter changed the listen port to avoid a clash with tizen-youtube, which also listens on a default port.

name: Samsung QN85A
summary: Reported working, and back after a reboot. This report came without a numbered issue.

name: Samsung AU7000
status: Dashboard works; root agent did not connect
summary: Service and dashboard reported working; the root agent did not connect (the Host PC IP step was not confirmed), so the features that need it stay off.

name: Samsung AU7172
summary: Vetro 0.5.0, diagnostic report only: root agent with UID 0, service running and loopback probe succeeded. Whether it starts by itself after a cold boot was not checked.

name: Samsung Q67B
summary: Reported working on firmware 1720.7, the same firmware family as several other 2022 reports.

name: Samsung Q60B
summary: Vetro 0.5.0 on a 43-inch Q60B: dashboard, UID-0 agent, launcher and the physical Home key verified. Service, root and launcher came back by themselves after a software restart, observed after about 100 s. Recovery after a power cut was not tested.

name: Samsung UE65BU8002
summary: Reported working. The Launcher needed the 0.3.1 fix for the Home cache folder before it started on this TV.

name: Samsung QE75QN85B
summary: Core functions were reported working. The Launcher failed before 0.3.1 because of the Home cache folder.

name: Samsung QN90B
summary: Reported working with Vetro 0.5.0, installed with Apps2Samsung: root agent with UID 0 after setting Host PC IP to 127.0.0.1 and restarting. The physical Home key opens a custom launcher. Another cold boot was not tested.

name: Samsung QN55S95B
summary: Reported working on a US-market QD-OLED model.

name: Samsung The Frame LS03B
summary: Reported working. The service started by itself after a cold boot. The Launcher was not tried on this TV. A second LS03B owner later ran the launcher with Vetro 0.5.0 and tested the SVT Play fix that 0.7.0 includes (#200, #211).

name: Samsung Q65S95C
summary: Reported working on a 2023 QD-OLED model.

name: Samsung S90C
summary: Reported working on Tizen 7.0.

name: Samsung GU75CU7179
summary: Reported working on Tizen 9.0, installed with Apps2Samsung. A 2023 TV reported on Tizen 9.0 shows why model year alone does not tell you the installed Tizen version.

name: Samsung CU8070
summary: Reported working with Vetro 0.5.0, installed with Apps2Samsung: root agent with UID 0 after setting Host PC IP to 127.0.0.1 and restarting. The physical Home key opens a custom launcher, with Samsung Home kept. Like the GU75CU7179, it is a 2023 TV reported on Tizen 9.0.

name: Samsung QN55Q65D
summary: Reported working, installed with Apps2Samsung.

name: Samsung Q60D
status: Reported working in a Reddit comment
description: Samsung Q60D with Vetro: reported working in a Reddit comment that gave no model code, firmware, Tizen or Vetro version. What that report can tell you.
summary: Reported working in a Reddit comment. No model code, firmware, Tizen or Vetro version was given, so this is the least detailed report on the list.

name: Samsung S90D
summary: Reported working on Tizen 9, with the root agent back after a full restart (the owner's account).

name: Samsung Crystal UHD DUE77
summary: Reported working with Vetro 0.3.5: root agent with UID 0 after a full restart without opening Vetro. The bundled launcher opens from the physical Home key.

name: Samsung Smart Monitor M8
summary: Installed, with the service and root agent running. What works beyond that has not been reported yet.
description: Samsung Smart Monitor M8 with Vetro: service and root agent reported running on firmware T-PTMWWC-1720.7. Feature testing and Tizen version were not reported.

name: Samsung QN80F
status: Lost root after an update to Tizen 10
description: Samsung QN80F with Vetro: root was lost when a firmware update moved the TV to Tizen 10. What still works on Tizen 10 and what to do before an update.
summary: Root stopped working when a firmware update moved this TV to Tizen 10, so the launcher, privacy switches and remapper no longer run on it. Tizen 10 has no root method yet.

name: Samsung M70H
status: Dashboard works; no root on Tizen 10
description: Samsung M70H on Tizen 10.0 with Vetro: the service and dashboard ran, but the TV closed the SDB connection Vetro uses to get root. Why there is no root yet.
summary: Reported on Tizen 10.0 with Vetro 0.3.5; the firmware version could not be read. The service and dashboard ran, but the TV's local SDB daemon closed the connection before the handshake finished, so the root agent never started.

name: Samsung TU7090
summary: Dashboard, app list and diagnostics reported working; features that need root access are unavailable.

name: Samsung T4300
summary: Dashboard, app list and diagnostics reported working; features that need root access are unavailable.

name: Samsung Q80R
summary: Works only with local changes, not with the stock package: a personal port with its own launcher host, app registry paths and Node.js 16.20.2. It was not reviewed or merged.

name: Samsung UE43NU7090
summary: Dashboard, app list and diagnostics reported working; features that need root access are unavailable.
